title: More form controls
summary: Use select, textarea, radio buttons, checkboxes, fieldset and legend.

quiz.q: How do you make radio buttons act as one group where only one can be chosen?
quiz.explain: Radios with the same `name` belong to one group. Ids must always be different from each other.

quiz.q: Complete the element that gives a group of controls its caption.
Which elements can you use for a **multi-line** message box and a **drop-down**?
quiz.explain: `textarea` is for long text and `select` with `option` items is the drop-down. `option` alone cannot show a list.

quiz.q: Click the line that stops these two radios working as a group.
quiz.code:
<input type="radio" id="a" name="size" value="s">
<label for="a">Small</label>
<input type="radio" id="b" name="sizes" value="l">
<label for="b">Large</label>
quiz.explain: The second radio uses `sizes` instead of `size`, so the browser treats it as another group and both can be selected.

exercise.task:
Complete the feedback form in `index.html`.

- A `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>` that says `Level`, holding three radio buttons that share `name="level"`, each with a `value`.
- A checkbox with `name="newsletter"`.
- A `<select id="course">` with at least 3 `<option>` items.
- A `<textarea id="comments">` with a `rows` attribute.
- Every control has a `<label for="...">` (at least 6 labels).
hints: Do the radio group first: three inputs, one name, three labels.
A label needs for="id" matching the control. select and textarea use the same pattern as input.

<fieldset>
  <legend>Level</legend>
  <input type="radio" id="l1" name="level" value="beginner">
  <label for="l1">Beginner</label>
  ...
</fieldset>
<input type="checkbox" id="news" name="newsletter">
<label for="news">Send me news</label>
<label for="course">Course</label>
<select id="course" name="course"><option>CS</option><option>EE</option><option>ME</option></select>
<label for="comments">Comments</label>
<textarea id="comments" name="comments" rows="4"></textarea>

checks.name: At least 3 radios inside the fieldset share name "level"
Every radio has a value
checks.hint: Add a different value="..." to each radio.

checks.name: The select #course has at least 3 options
The textarea #comments has a rows attribute
There are at least 6 labels with a for attribute
checks.hint: Give each control (3 radios, checkbox, select, textarea) its own label.
